info.name: Talk Enhancer (Fork by Sairento)
info.summary: Huriko Talk Enhancements: AI Ollama Assistant, Webhooks, OCC Console Toolkit, Atom One Dark syntax highlighting & multimedia suite
info.description: Fork by Sairento for Huriko Cloud (cloud.huriko.com). Enhances Nextcloud Talk with: - Server-Side OCC Console Commands: * occ talk:enhancer:stats (activity, messages, room stats and AI connectivity) * occ talk:enhancer:broadcast (send admin announcements to all rooms or selected rooms) * occ talk:enhancer:cleanup (retention policy message purger and cache cleaner) * occ talk:enhancer:export-room (full room export to JSON, Markdown, or HTML) - Incoming Webhooks API (/api/v1/webhook/{token}) for Home Assistant, GitHub, Zabbix, and Bash alerts - Local AI Assistant (/api/v1/ai/ask) with Ollama / LocalAI integration and /ai command in chat - Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scanner detecting exposed private keys, API tokens, and credentials - Background retention cleanup job running automatically via Nextcloud cron - Atom One Dark syntax highlighting for 190+ programming languages - Copy to clipboard button on every code block with language badges - Smart code paste that auto-detects code snippets and wraps them into markdown blocks - In-call privacy protections preventing accidental mic leaks on close (Issue #2003) - AI Noise Suppression (RNNoise WASM), Screen & Call Clip Recorder (/record), Meeting Notes (/summary) - Zen Mode (Alt+Z), Canvas Image Optimizer, WebRTC Quality Meter, GIF Picker (/gif), and Pinned Messages - WebSocket Reverse Proxy Watchdog with silent auto-reconnect (Issue #19994) - Compact Bulk Attachment Gallery view grouping multi-file uploads (PR #19952) - Unread Reaction Indicator for 1-to-1 conversations (Issue #19852) - Współdzielona Tablica do Rysowania (Interactive Whiteboard) z narzędziami szkicowania, kształtów i eksportem PNG - Planowanie Wysyłki Wiadomości (Scheduled Messages) z automatycznym wysyłaniem w zadanym czasie
